prompt: An empty metal chair stands in the centre of a bare concrete interrogation room, lit from directly above by one bare hanging bulb that throws a hard circle of light on the floor. On the grey wall behind it hangs a plain poster of a man's face with a thick black bar across his eyes. The corners of the room fall into deep crosshatched shadow, seen from eye level straight on. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
